compiled_state.title: Differ surfaces unbindable states as explicit conflict and probe Mutations
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-5: Differ surfaces unbindable/inconsistent states as explicit Mutation entries (action=conflict or action=probe), not silent no-ops

Extend differ.py to detect and emit explicit Mutations for unbindable/inconsistent states: (a) Jira issue references dso_local_id with no matching local ticket -> emit (inbound, conflict) with provenance describing dangling reference; (b) local ticket has dso_local_id set but no matching Jira issue with ambiguous binding intent -> emit (outbound, probe) with provenance describing ambiguity; (c) two local tickets share same dso_local_id -> emit (inbound, conflict) per collision. No state silently dropped.

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given jira_state containing issue referencing dso_local_id=ZZZ that does not exist in local_state; When diff is called; Then result contains exactly one Mutation with (direction=inbound, action=conflict, target=jira_key) whose provenance names the dangling dso_local_id ZZZ, and zero silent no-ops for that anomaly.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/differ.py tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ_conflict_resolution.py
- [ ] Dangling dso_local_id on Jira side emits (inbound, conflict) Mutation
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ_conflict_resolution.py::test_dangling_jira_ref_emits_inbound_conflict
- [ ] Ambiguous local binding emits (outbound, probe) Mutation
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ_conflict_resolution.py::test_ambiguous_local_binding_emits_outbound_probe
- [ ] Duplicate dso_local_id across local tickets emits one (inbound, conflict) per collision
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ_conflict_resolution.py::test_duplicate_local_id_emits_conflict_per_collision

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/differ.py — Edit
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ_conflict_resolution.py — Edit

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1 (Step 4 plan review feedback): Name 3 distinct tests explicitly: (1) test_dangling_jira_ref_emits_inbound_conflict — Given jira_state issue references dso_local_id=ZZZ with no matching local; When diff called; Then exactly one (inbound, conflict, target=jira_key) with provenance naming ZZZ. (2) test_duplicate_dso_local_id_emits_inbound_conflict_per_collision — Given jira_state with two issues both having dso_local_id=X; When diff called; Then exactly two (inbound, conflict) Mutations with distinct jira_keys. (3) test_ambiguous_local_binding_emits_outbound_probe — Given local_state with ticket whose binding is ambiguous; When diff called; Then (outbound, probe) Mutation emitted. Add conflict-vs-probe definition to differ.py docstring: 'conflict = Jira-side anomaly (dangling ref, duplicate dso_local_id); probe = local-side ambiguity (local ticket cannot be deterministically bound to a single Jira issue, triggering probe action to resolve binding).'
